description: Thorn ticks from standing in or walking through something: cactus; sweetBerryBush, which also covers Immersive Weathering leaf piles and weeds and the Vinery taiga grape bush; Farmer's Respite wither roots; Neapolitan beanstalk thorns; Dustrial Decor barbed panes. Shields only attempt these on tiers with [shields.<tier>].blocksContactTicks = true (diamond and above by default), and then block them from any direction at the physical percentage.
